# ScaleAndFit (scaleandfit.com)

ScaleAndFit is a 100% client-side, multilingual (EN, NL, FR, DE, ES) utility platform housing four precision studio suites:

- visual-sizer (/visual-sizer/) — Visual TV/monitor/mattress scale overlays & airline carry-on sizer checks across 34 airlines
- printable-paper (/printable-paper/) — Client-side vector PDF dot-grid, graph, Cornell notes, holiday calendars & Avery labels
- size-converter (/size-converter/) — Millimeter Mondopoint brand shoe matrix & credit-card calibrated ring sizer
- passport-photo (/passport-photo/) — Local passport/visa photo cropper, webcam capture & 300-DPI 4x6 print sheet generator

## Additional Information, Guides & Legal Pages

- /guides/ (plus /nl/guides/, /fr/guides/, /de/guides/, /es/guides/) — Illustrated step-by-step guides and 100% scale printer calibration check sheets
- /about/ — Engineering & measurement standards (ICAO Doc 9303, ISO 9407, ISO 8653, ISO/IEC 7810 ID-1)
- /privacy/ — Zero server photo uploads, local HTML5 Canvas processing
- /terms/ — Usage notes & official verification reminders
- /cookies/ — Zero analytics/tracking cookies; optional sf-theme and sf-lang storage keys only
- /contact/ — Corrections & dataset inquiries (othrys.systems@gmail.com)

All math, PDF synthesis, and image cropping execute strictly on the user's device.
